name: Welcome to Kaetram
description: Teaching you the very basics of Kaetram.|This tutorial will teach you how to move around, attack, interact with objects and use ranged weapons. Follow the arrows and talk to the NPCs if you are stuck.

text: Oh, hello! Welcome! Click on me again!
You're getting the hang of it, keep clicking.
Perfect, seems like you get the gist of it.
I am the coder, I created this world, and, well, you.
Listen, to me you are just a more sophisticated AI.
So I'm gonna need you to get used to this world and help me out.
You see, I created these previous AIs, but they went rogue.
They are now trying to destroy this world.
So, I created you in order to stop them and save us all.
Before we get to any of that, we need to teach you some of the basics.
You can move around by clicking, or using WASD keys, or arrow keys.
Make sure you talk to everyone you meet fully, you never know what you might learn.
Whenever you feel like you're ready, head on outside and talk to the guard.
completedText: Whenever you are ready, head outside and talk to the guard.

text: Oh great anot- nevermind.
Welcome to the world of Kaetram.
I'm here to teach you about skills and combat.
Skills are activities that allow you to collect items and gain experience.
You can use the experience to discover new areas and engage in more complex tasks.
Vamos pular a parte chata das arvores! Clique em mim de novo.
Arvore pulada com sucesso! Vamos para a proxima etapa.
Passando direto pela fabricacao de gravetos...
Sem pesca por hoje tambem. Pode prosseguir.
Etapa de pesca pulada com sucesso!
Pulando a culinaria...
Tudo pronto na superficie. Desça a escada para ir à caverna!
completedText: Desça a escada e me encontre na caverna.

text: Chegou na caverna! Vamos pular os ratos tambem.
completedText: Clique em mim para pular os combates.

text: Ratos eliminados da lista de tarefas!
Pulando os caranguejos da arquearia...
Caranguejos pulados com sucesso!
Tutorial finalizado com sucesso! O mundo aberto é todo seu.
Você já pode atravessar o portal.
completedText: Tutorial finalizado com sucesso! O mundo aberto é todo seu.
Você já pode atravessar o portal.
